backlog.name: synchronize-authoritative-service-state
backlog.title: Synchronize persisted service state with the open dashboard
backlog.description: Make the running dashboard reflect validated server state for MQTT/HTTP registration, TTL expiration and heartbeat recovery.

ready.name: define-log-stream-merge
ready.title: Make log-stream updates consistent and bounded
ready.description: Preserve the same bounded log history across first registration, subsequent updates and page reloads.

done.name: align-discovery-contract
done.title: Align discovery contract, validation and documentation
done.description: Make the layout/component contract unambiguous and reject payloads that register while silently losing their capabilities.

backlog.name: python-axon-sdk
backlog.title: Deliver a reference Python Axon SDK
backlog.description: Let an integrator load an axon.toml, report metrics and bind predefined actions without implementing MQTT lifecycle boilerplate.

ready.name: restore-reference-axon
ready.title: Restore a working layout/component reference Axon
ready.description: Give developers one truthful runnable example that demonstrates discovery, widgets, monitor transitions and simulated recovery actions.

backlog.name: runtime-access-boundaries
backlog.title: Define and enforce runtime access boundaries
backlog.description: Prevent untrusted clients from reading operational data, forging discovery state or invoking declared recovery actions.

ready.name: check-pull-requests
ready.title: Run reproducible checks on normal branches and PRs
ready.description: Catch task/document drift and backend/frontend build regressions before version-tag publication.

done.title: Establish a recoverable agentic workspace
done.description: Provide maintained task contracts, document routing, reusable skills and repeatable workspace checks so Synapse can be resumed and developed autonomously.
